SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO

GO

CREATE PROC [BNKM].[SP_CurrencyConversionAdministration] AS
BEGIN

--GET DELTA FROM BUSC

WITH Temp_BNKM_CurrencyConversionAdministration AS (
    SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CurrencyConversionTimestamp, ConvertFromIsoCurrencyId, ConvertToIsoCurrencyId, RateId, FinancialInstitutionId ORDER BY RateListNumber DESC) AS rn, * FROM (
        SELECT RTLIST_DATE AS CurrencyConversionTimestamp
        ,RTLIST_NUM as RateListNumber
        ,FXD_CRNCY_CODE AS ConvertFromIsoCurrencyId
        ,VAR_CRNCY_CODE AS ConvertToIsoCurrencyId
        ,RATECODE AS RateId
        ,RCRE_USER_ID AS EmployeeId
        ,'Create' AdministrationTypeId
        ,RCRE_TIME AS AdministrationTimestamp
        ,'GLD' AS SourceSystemCode
        ,BANK_ID AS FinancialInstitutionId
        ,0 AS WorkFlowId
        ,0 AS TaskRunId
        ,getdate() AS InsertDttm
    FROM BUSC.GLD_RATELIST_HIST_TABLE
    WHERE isLatest = 1
    )a

    UNION

    SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CurrencyConversionTimestamp, ConvertFromIsoCurrencyId, ConvertToIsoCurrencyId, RateId, FinancialInstitutionId ORDER BY RateListNumber DESC) AS rn, * FROM (
        SELECT RTLIST_DATE AS CurrencyConversionTimestamp
        ,RTLIST_NUM as RateListNumber
        ,FXD_CRNCY_CODE AS ConvertFromIsoCurrencyId
        ,VAR_CRNCY_CODE AS ConvertToIsoCurrencyId
        ,RATECODE AS RateId
        ,LCHG_USER_ID AS EmployeeId
        ,'Modify' AdministrationTypeId
        ,LCHG_TIME AS AdministrationTimestamp
        ,'GLD' AS SourceSystemCode
        ,BANK_ID AS FinancialInstitutionId
        ,0 AS WorkFlowId
        ,0 AS TaskRunId
        ,getdate() AS InsertDttm
    FROM BUSC.GLD_RATELIST_HIST_TABLE
    WHERE isLatest = 1
    )a
)


--CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA

SELECT * INTO #Temp_BNKM_CurrencyConversionAdministration FROM Temp_BNKM_CurrencyConversionAdministration WHERE rn = 1;

WITH Temp_BNKM_CurrencyConversionAdministration_SRC as(
SELECT 
CurrencyConversionTimestamp
,ConvertFromIsoCurrencyId
,ConvertToIsoCurrencyId
,RateId
,FinancialInstitutionId
,AdministrationTypeId
,AdministrationTimestamp
,EmployeeId
,SourceSystemCode
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm
FROM #Temp_BNKM_CurrencyConversionAdministration
)
,
Temp_BNKM_CurrencyConversionAdministration_TGT as(
SELECT 
CurrencyConversionTimestamp
,ConvertFromIsoCurrencyId
,ConvertToIsoCurrencyId
,RateId
,FinancialInstitutionId
,AdministrationTypeId
,AdministrationTimestamp
,EmployeeId
,SourceSystemCode
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm
FROM BNKM.CurrencyConversionAdministration
)
,
Temp_BNKM_CurrencyConversionAdministration_DELTA
AS(
SELECT
ISNULL(SRC.CurrencyConversionTimestamp,TGT.CurrencyConversionTimestamp) AS CurrencyConversionTimestamp
,ISNULL(SRC.ConvertFromIsoCurrencyId,TGT.ConvertFromIsoCurrencyId) AS ConvertFromIsoCurrencyId
,ISNULL(SRC.ConvertToIsoCurrencyId,TGT.ConvertToIsoCurrencyId) AS ConvertToIsoCurrencyId
,ISNULL(SRC.RateId,TGT.RateId) AS RateId
,ISNULL(SRC.FinancialInstitutionId,TGT.FinancialInstitutionId) AS FinancialInstitutionId
,ISNULL(SRC.EmployeeId,TGT.EmployeeId) AS EmployeeId
,ISNULL(SRC.AdministrationTimestamp,TGT.AdministrationTimestamp) AS AdministrationTimestamp
,ISNULL(SRC.AdministrationTypeId,TGT.AdministrationTypeId) AS AdministrationTypeId

FROM Temp_BNKM_CurrencyConversionAdministration_SRC SRC
LEFT JOIN TEMP_BNKM_CurrencyConversionAdministration_TGT TGT
ON isnull(SRC.CurrencyConversionTimestamp, '1900-01-01') = isnull(TGT.CurrencyConversionTimestamp, '1900-01-01')
AND SRC.CurrencyConversionTimestamp = TGT.CurrencyConversionTimestamp
AND SRC.ConvertFromIsoCurrencyId = TGT.ConvertFromIsoCurrencyId
AND SRC.ConvertToIsoCurrencyId = TGT.ConvertToIsoCurrencyId
AND SRC.RateId = TGT.RateId
AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
AND SRC.EmployeeId = TGT.EmployeeId
AND SRC.AdministrationTimestamp = TGT.AdministrationTimestamp
AND SRC.AdministrationTypeId = TGT.AdministrationTypeId
WHERE TGT.CurrencyConversionTimestamp IS NULL
)

--INSERT RECORDS TO BNKM

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CurrencyConversionAdministration_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_CurrencyConversionAdministration_DELTA;

INSERT INTO BNKM.CurrencyConversionAdministration(
CurrencyConversionTimestamp
,ConvertFromIsoCurrencyId
,ConvertToIsoCurrencyId
,RateId
,FinancialInstitutionId
,AdministrationTypeId
,AdministrationTimestamp
,EmployeeId
,SourceSystemCode
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm
)SELECT DISTINCT
SRC.CurrencyConversionTimestamp
,SRC.ConvertFromIsoCurrencyId
,SRC.ConvertToIsoCurrencyId
,SRC.RateId
,SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
,SRC.AdministrationTypeId
,SRC.AdministrationTimestamp
,SRC.EmployeeId
,SourceSystemCode
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm
FROM #Temp_BNKM_CurrencyConversionAdministration SRC
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CurrencyConversionAdministration_DELTA DLT
ON SRC.CurrencyConversionTimestamp = DLT.CurrencyConversionTimestamp
AND SRC.ConvertFromIsoCurrencyId = DLT.ConvertFromIsoCurrencyId
AND SRC.ConvertToIsoCurrencyId = DLT.ConvertToIsoCurrencyId
AND SRC.RateId = DLT.RateId
AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = DLT.FinancialInstitutionId
AND SRC.AdministrationTypeId = DLT.AdministrationTypeId
AND SRC.AdministrationTimestamp = DLT.AdministrationTimestamp
AND SRC.EmployeeId = DLT.EmployeeId

DROP TABLE #Temp_BNKM_CurrencyConversionAdministration;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CurrencyConversionAdministration_DELTA;

END
GO
